name: Ferris Jukebox
author: Ferris Derbidge
description: A guest-safe, mobile-friendly FPP jukebox for approved playlists and MP4 projection shows.

privacy.summary: Runs on this FPP device only. Guests can request only playlists explicitly approved by the FPP administrator.
privacy.other: No cloud service, analytics, accounts, or external network access.
